<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one carbon resonance falls in the typical methyl region (~10‑30 ppm): a peak at 26.40 ppm. The other low‑field signals (36.40 ppm) are more consistent with methylene or tertiary carbons, and the remaining peaks correspond to carbonyl, aromatic, and hetero‑atom‑bound carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
